title: After the owner changes the gym's UPI ID, members are still shown the old one to pay
what: Each payment asked of a member (a fee, or a shop order) keeps the UPI ID the gym had on the day it was made. When the owner saves a new UPI ID, only the gym's setting changes. A member's open fee and any open shop order keep showing the old QR, the old Pay by UPI app link and the old ID to copy, for up to 30 days, and a shop order reuses that same request each time the member taps pay. Money sent that way goes to an account the gym may no longer use, or to a staff member's old ID.
expected: Every open payment shows the gym's current UPI ID; changing it updates or remakes the open ones.
how_often: each time a gym changes its UPI ID while payments are open
fix_line: Read the gym's current UPI ID when showing an open payment

title: A shop order paid in the app still says pay at the desk
what: Under every order that is Ordered or Ready the app always writes Pay at the desk when you collect it, or Pay when you collect it. It does not look at whether the order was already paid online. So a paid order shows Paid. The gym can see it. and, on the same card, Pay at the desk. The order placed message and the bag also say pay at the desk and nothing is charged in the app, while the order card offers Pay for this order. With the gym's Shop page also showing the order as unpaid, the member is likely to pay twice.
expected: A paid order says it is paid and drops the pay-at-desk line; the bag and order messages mention that paying in the app is possible when it is on.
how_often: every shop order paid in the app
fix_line: Hide the pay-at-desk line when the order is paid, and word the bag for both ways

title: After paying for a shop order online, the order still shows the pay buttons
what: When the member comes back from the payment page or a UPI app, the membership fee box asks again and turns to Paid. The shop order does not: My orders only reads the payments when the page is opened, its 10-second refresh reloads orders but not payments, and nothing asks the payment company on return. The card keeps the QR, Pay by UPI app and Pay online until the member leaves and reopens the page, so the member cannot tell it worked and may pay again by UPI.
expected: Coming back to the app re-checks the order's payment and shows Paid at once, as the membership box does.
fix_line: Re-check an open shop payment when the app comes back to the front

title: When the gym's payment link runs out, the Pay your gym box disappears with no word
what: A fee the desk asked for is shown only while its payment is open or was paid in the last 3 days. Once the payment company says the link ran out, the server marks it ran out and the app's list leaves it out, so the whole Pay your gym box, with the UPI QR that never runs out, vanishes. The words This payment link has run out. Ask the desk for a new one. appear only if the member happens to be on the screen at that moment. The member still owes the money but the app now looks as if nothing is due.
expected: A fee whose link ran out stays listed with the amount, the UPI way to pay, and the line to ask the desk for a new link.
how_often: each fee link that runs out before the member pays
fix_line: Keep ran-out fees in the member's list with the ask-the-desk line

title: With no internet, Pay for this order says the gym has not set up online payment
what: Tapping Pay for this order with weak or no signal, or when the server is slow, gets no answer. The app reads every missing answer as Online payment is not set up at this gym yet. Pay at the desk., and keeps saying it until the page is opened again, even at a gym where paying online works.
expected: No answer says there is no connection and offers to try again.
how_often: each pay tap without a working connection
fix_line: Tell a failed call apart from a gym without online payment
